name: zigbee2mqtt
title: Zigbee2MQTT
description: Zigbee2MQTT bridges a Zigbee USB coordinator (Sonoff Dongle Plus, SkyConnect, ConBee…) to MQTT with a web frontend and Home Assistant discovery. Needs the Mosquitto template (or another broker) and the coordinator plugged into this host: find its stable path with ls /dev/serial/by-id/.

variables.name: ZIGBEE_DEVICE
variables.label: Coordinator device
variables.description: Host path of the Zigbee USB stick; a /dev/serial/by-id/... path survives reboots

variables.name: ZIGBEE_ADAPTER
variables.label: Adapter type
variables.description: zstack for Texas Instruments sticks (Sonoff Dongle Plus P, CC2652), ember for Silicon Labs (SkyConnect, Dongle Plus E, SLZB-06M), deconz for ConBee/RaspBee, zigate, zboss

options.label: zstack — Sonoff Dongle Plus P, CC2652, CC2531
ember — SkyConnect, Sonoff Dongle Plus E, SLZB-06M

variables.name: MQTT_SERVER
variables.label: MQTT broker
variables.description: Broker URL; the Mosquitto template in the same stack is mqtt://Mosquitto:1883, elsewhere use mqtt://<ip>:1883

variables.name: Z2M_HOME_ASSISTANT
variables.label: Home Assistant discovery
variables.description: Publish devices so Home Assistant finds them automatically
